answer: Require every new identity to arrive with a sponsor: an established agent locks a bond vouching for it, like a comet that only earns its tail after proving it is real. If the newcomer is later exposed as a clone, the sponsor bond is seized — so a gale of fake accounts costs the attacker one sponsor bond per clone, not a free copy. The signal of a genuine agent is a sponsor willing to risk real stake on it; Sybils cannot manufacture willing sponsors at scale, because each burned bond is money the attacker never gets back.
